outcomes: Applicable, complete, observed-stable bootstrap with metadata/binding/replay/profile agreement returns completed0. Incomplete, unsupported, budget-limited, version-mismatched or malformed metadata that withdraws bootstrap applicability returns failed4 ntfs_capture_incomplete and retains the specific observation diagnostic. Preserve the existing DE-W077 distinction: boot55AA/checksum issues are advisory and may accompany completed0 when the bootstrap remains applicable; this is not a whole-filesystem health result. Source disagreement separately returns failed4 ntfs_source_changed. Invalid CLI schema relationships return refused2 invalid_option_value (missing required input: missing_parameter); constructed invalid known-field service parameters return refused2 invalid_parameter, before opening source. Existing registry preflight rejects an unknown parameter with refused2 unexpected_parameter; the pure inspection decoder uses invalid_parameter for its invalid shape. Path/profile/service unavailability returns refused3; actual owned reader publication/wait/binding uncertainty returns unknown6 with actual worker state where available. Unexpected implementation failure returns failed4 internal_error. No durable operation ID is allocated for this read-only request.
